# Make it Squeaky

> Residential cleaning in the City of Toronto, run by Tiffany. Over a decade of professional cleaning experience, one set of hands on every job — no crews, no subcontractors. Regular, deep, move-in/move-out and post-renovation cleaning, each job quoted personally.

Service area: the City of Toronto (every postal code starting with M). Just outside the city, in the GTA, is by request — Tiffany sometimes travels for a fee agreed with the customer beforehand.

Services: Regular Cleaning (upkeep for a home already in good order); Deep Cleaning (everything in Regular, plus detailed scrubbing, baseboards, trim, soap scum and buildup); Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning (everything in Deep, plus closets, shelves, sills and tracks, for an empty property); Post-Renovation Cleaning (fine construction dust and light residue after the trades have gone). Add-ons available on any clean: inside oven, inside refrigerator, interior windows, inside cabinets and drawers, wall washing, inside kitchen appliances.

How a quote works: the quote form asks for the service, the postal code, the approximate square footage (or estimates it from home type, bedrooms and bathrooms), any add-ons, and three questions about the home — heavy grime or buildup, more pet hair than usual, heavy construction residue — then sends the request to Tiffany on WhatsApp. No price is shown on the site: Tiffany quotes every job herself and comes back to the customer. Nothing is booked or paid for on the site.

Booking terms: no deposit is taken today and there is no cancellation charge today. When online booking opens, a 50% deposit for full-day cleans and a 48-hour cancellation window take effect.

Contact: phone/text +1 (416) 564-2125, email tiffanypoerazoff10@gmail.com.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://makeitsqueaky.com/): Overview of the business, the four cleans, and the start of a quote.
- [Get a quote](https://makeitsqueaky.com/quote.html): Describe the home — service, postal code, square footage or a bedroom/bathroom estimate, add-ons, a few condition questions — and send it to Tiffany.
- [Services](https://makeitsqueaky.com/services.html): What each of the four cleans includes, the add-ons, the service area, and the booking terms.
- [About](https://makeitsqueaky.com/about.html): Background on Tiffany and how the business operates, then how to reach her.
- [Booking terms](https://makeitsqueaky.com/services.html#terms-heading): Service area, deposit and cancellation — what applies today and what changes when online booking opens.
